text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: A buck alternates inductor charging from the source with a freewheel interval

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal nonsynchronous CCM buck at50 kHz,D=0.4,V_in=12 V,L=100 µH,C=47 µF,mean I_L=2 A. Diode anode is return, cathode switch node; when Q is off it carries freewheel
current upward. V_o=D V_in and ΔI_L=0.576 A. Output ripple is the integrated zero-mean capacitor current with ESR neglected, using constant average V_o in the
inductor slopes. Gate drive, losses and startup are omitted.
